bbmp_smufi: smufi_engine.cpp and engine.h from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/retro, commit 19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged
(GPL-3.0-or-later, SPDX line in each file, COPYING). Picatune 1 songs (.smufi, BeRo 2006): a clean-room synthesizer tracker replayer (from a
description of the format only; bbmp docs/replayers.md, engine `picatune`). Only these two files of csrc/retro are vendored; the helper
functions of retro:: (register_engine, field) are in plugins/replayers/bbmp_smufi/shim.cpp.
